notes: CPU milliseconds include FIFO feeding and analysis. FFT-only wall measurements have different magnitude-pass scope across variants; use complete-update wall cost.
Timing reductions are observations, with no performance threshold or statistical significance gate. Shared-runner variation remains visible in raw trials.
FIFO pending/discarded values are asserted by the C++ test but absent from cost CSV columns; do not invent separate observed values.
Zero-FFT consumer updates are legitimate when a batch is shorter than one hop. Consumer totals include them; no zero-update timing row is discarded.
CSV consistency PASS is separate from the CTest process result and from untested DAW/audio-interface real-time acceptance.

cost_accounting.per_update_zero_window_observation: Not available in these cost CSVs; expected fixture counts only.

eq-analyzer-temporal-coverage.csv.interpretation: Each attack detected with the bounded N/2+N/4 observation tail; early high-rate attacks also present at 40 ms.

eq-analyzer-fifo-stalls.csv.interpretation: 192 kHz x 500 ms produces 96,000 samples; its expected 30,464 FIFO drops plus 65,536 discarded stale frames are intentional recovery tests.

eq-analyzer-audio-invariance.csv.interpretation: ON/OFF whole-processor outputs remain bit-identical despite deliberate FIFO overflow and analyzer reconfiguration.

eq-analyzer-callback.csv.interpretation: Observed software fixture timing only; not hardware or DAW acceptance.

eq-analyzer-cpu.csv.interpretation: Zero-call rows are included in the measured consumer sample set. CPU/UI attribution is outside this independent report.

backend.proof_limit: Local JUCE 8.0.8 backend/source audit; no remote binary symbol dump supplied.
